issues.on_page: OPERATING EXPENDITURES (Salaries ... Miscellaneous expense), total 1,259,804; Statement of Activities p3 'General and administrative'
issues.issue: NRD rule says function natural resources/conservation. general government is defensible because the Statement of Activities prints a 'General and administrative' function, but it's a judgment call. The same applies to the matching detail lines on pp11-12.

issues.on_page: Investment income 131,851 (= governmental 121,135 + business-type 10,716 per Statement of Activities p3)
issues.issue: This district-wide cash-basis line includes the rural water funds' interest of 10,716 but is tagged governmental only. The page doesn't split it, so it can't be split, but the fund type is mixed.

Totals match, but each printed total mixes governmental and business-type lines (rural water revenues 251,139, rural water disbursements 200,521). Any per-fund-type tie-out will need to treat this schedule as all funds.

Per p6 this is mostly Building construction 725,504 (with equipment 10,000, office equipment 11,439, vehicles 70,000). The dominant object is construction/infrastructure or land and buildings, not equipment purchases.
Category guess; could be professional/contract services or miscellaneous.
Vehicle costs probably include fuel; category is a judgment call.
